header.comment: This configuration file was automatically created by GParserBuilder

max_resubmissions.comment: The amount of resubmissions allowed if a full return of work
items was expected but only a subset has returned

wait_factor.comment: A static double factor for timeouts
It is suggested to use values >= 1.

min_partial_return_percentage.comment: Set to a value < 100 to allow execution to continue when
minPartialReturnPercentage percent of the expected work items
have returned. Set to 0 to disable this option.
